answer: Peer-audit bond against fake identities: each identity locks 80 credits and files a key-signed ember receipt. At dawn the beacon draws three raven auditors to replay each ember receipt; two flags burn it. A fake costs 40 spent, 80 locked; 1,000 fakes spend 40,000, lock 80,000, for a 40,000 pool. A rented-raven ring fails: dawn draws are random, and a raven approving an exposed fake loses its bond. An honest agent pays 15 once, gets 80 back.
